Your Perspective Matters

This survey is designed to support this individual in understanding how their leadership behaviours and thinking are experienced by the people around them.

As a 360° feedback experience, it brings together observations from people who interact with them in different roles and situations. Every response contributes an important perspective. The more people who participate, the clearer and more meaningful the overall picture becomes.

Your thoughtful and authentic feedback will help them recognise what is working well, understand how their leadership is landing with others, and identify meaningful opportunities for learning and development.

Please base your responses on what you have genuinely observed or experienced.
